statement: OpenAI booked $13.1 billion of revenue in 2025 against a 2025 operating loss of $20.9 billion.
why: Losses larger than revenue mean a major compute buyer depends on outside capital to keep paying for GPUs, so its purchasing is tied to funding conditions.

impact.mechanism: A cash-burning marginal buyer must keep raising capital to sustain compute commitments, so any funding tightening would flow straight through to accelerator orders.

evidence.excerpt: Actual booked revenue for 2025 was "$13.1 billion," against a 2025 operating loss of "$20.9 billion."

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet reporting figures not published by the company itself.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> unknown); sources: The Motley Fool
